chunks: To God belong the East and the West. Wherever you turn, there is the face of God. Indeed, God is All-Pervading, All-Knowing.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's presence in all directions?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for resolving the theological tension between God's transcendence (tanzih) and immanence (tashbih), affirming that while He is beyond physical direction, His presence encompasses all creation. It underscores the concept of 'Wasi' (All-Encompassing) and 'Alim' (All-Knowing), serving as a basis for understanding how divine attributes manifest in the multiplicity of the world without being limited by it.
